🪲fix(benchmark): isolate container test from runner environment (#5)

## Summary

The pre-measurement test suite fails on Ubicloud because the container
isolation test inherits `BENCH_RUNNER_PROVIDER` and `BENCH_RUNNER_IMAGE`
from the measurement job, then incorrectly rejects the resulting public
`--env` arguments. This blocked [run
39938329596](https://github.com/qortoo/qortoo-bench/actions/runs/39938329596)
before performance measurements.

Give the no-environment container test an explicit empty environment
fixture. Existing runner environment tests continue to verify that only
the two public identity fields are forwarded and credentials are
excluded. Production measurement behavior is unchanged.

## Validation

- `BENCH_RUNNER_PROVIDER=ubicloud BENCH_RUNNER_IMAGE=ubuntu24 python3 -m
unittest discover -s tests` — 55 passed.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` — 55 passed.
- `actionlint`, `python3 -m compileall -q scripts tests`, and `git diff
--check` — passed.

After merge, retry the original request with its fixed SDK source
selection to verify measurement and publication on Ubicloud.

commit.message:
🪲fix(benchmark): isolate container test from runner environment (#5)

## Summary

The pre-measurement test suite fails on Ubicloud because the container
isolation test inherits `BENCH_RUNNER_PROVIDER` and `BENCH_RUNNER_IMAGE`
from the measurement job, then incorrectly rejects the resulting public
`--env` arguments. This blocked [run
39938329596](https://github.com/qortoo/qortoo-bench/actions/runs/39938329596)
before performance measurements.

Give the no-environment container test an explicit empty environment
fixture. Existing runner environment tests continue to verify that only
the two public identity fields are forwarded and credentials are
excluded. Production measurement behavior is unchanged.

## Validation

- `BENCH_RUNNER_PROVIDER=ubicloud BENCH_RUNNER_IMAGE=ubuntu24 python3 -m
unittest discover -s tests` — 55 passed.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` — 55 passed.
- `actionlint`, `python3 -m compileall -q scripts tests`, and `git diff
--check` — passed.

After merge, retry the original request with its fixed SDK source

commit.message:
🪲fix(benchmark): isolate container test from runner environment (#5)

## Summary

The pre-measurement test suite fails on Ubicloud because the container
isolation test inherits `BENCH_RUNNER_PROVIDER` and `BENCH_RUNNER_IMAGE`
from the measurement job, then incorrectly rejects the resulting public
`--env` arguments. This blocked [run
39938329596](https://github.com/qortoo/qortoo-bench/actions/runs/39938329596)
before performance measurements.

Give the no-environment container test an explicit empty environment
fixture. Existing runner environment tests continue to verify that only
the two public identity fields are forwarded and credentials are
excluded. Production measurement behavior is unchanged.

## Validation

- `BENCH_RUNNER_PROVIDER=ubicloud BENCH_RUNNER_IMAGE=ubuntu24 python3 -m
unittest discover -s tests` — 55 passed.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` — 55 passed.
- `actionlint`, `python3 -m compileall -q scripts tests`, and `git diff
--check` — passed.

After merge, retry the original request with its fixed SDK source
selection to verify measurement and publication on Ubicloud.

commit.message:
🪲fix(benchmark): isolate container test from runner environment (#5)

## Summary

The pre-measurement test suite fails on Ubicloud because the container
isolation test inherits `BENCH_RUNNER_PROVIDER` and `BENCH_RUNNER_IMAGE`
from the measurement job, then incorrectly rejects the resulting public
`--env` arguments. This blocked [run
39938329596](https://github.com/qortoo/qortoo-bench/actions/runs/39938329596)
before performance measurements.

Give the no-environment container test an explicit empty environment
fixture. Existing runner environment tests continue to verify that only
the two public identity fields are forwarded and credentials are
excluded. Production measurement behavior is unchanged.

## Validation

- `BENCH_RUNNER_PROVIDER=ubicloud BENCH_RUNNER_IMAGE=ubuntu24 python3 -m
unittest discover -s tests` — 55 passed.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` — 55 passed.
- `actionlint`, `python3 -m compileall -q scripts tests`, and `git diff
--check` — passed.

After merge, retry the original request with its fixed SDK source
selection to verify measurement and publication on Ubicloud.

commit.message:
🪲fix(benchmark): isolate container test from runner environment (#5)

## Summary

The pre-measurement test suite fails on Ubicloud because the container
isolation test inherits `BENCH_RUNNER_PROVIDER` and `BENCH_RUNNER_IMAGE`
from the measurement job, then incorrectly rejects the resulting public
`--env` arguments. This blocked [run
39938329596](https://github.com/qortoo/qortoo-bench/actions/runs/39938329596)
before performance measurements.

Give the no-environment container test an explicit empty environment
fixture. Existing runner environment tests continue to verify that only
the two public identity fields are forwarded and credentials are
excluded. Production measurement behavior is unchanged.

## Validation

- `BENCH_RUNNER_PROVIDER=ubicloud BENCH_RUNNER_IMAGE=ubuntu24 python3 -m
unittest discover -s tests` — 55 passed.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` — 55 passed.
- `actionlint`, `python3 -m compileall -q scripts tests`, and `git diff
--check` — passed.

After merge, retry the original request with its fixed SDK source
selection to verify measurement and publication on Ubicloud.

commit.message:
🪲fix(benchmark): isolate container test from runner environment (#5)

## Summary

The pre-measurement test suite fails on Ubicloud because the container
isolation test inherits `BENCH_RUNNER_PROVIDER` and `BENCH_RUNNER_IMAGE`
from the measurement job, then incorrectly rejects the resulting public
`--env` arguments. This blocked [run
39938329596](https://github.com/qortoo/qortoo-bench/actions/runs/39938329596)
before performance measurements.

Give the no-environment container test an explicit empty environment
fixture. Existing runner environment tests continue to verify that only
the two public identity fields are forwarded and credentials are
excluded. Production measurement behavior is unchanged.

## Validation

- `BENCH_RUNNER_PROVIDER=ubicloud BENCH_RUNNER_IMAGE=ubuntu24 python3 -m
unittest discover -s tests` — 55 passed.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` — 55 passed.
- `actionlint`, `python3 -m compileall -q scripts tests`, and `git diff
--check` — passed.

After merge, retry the original request with its fixed SDK source
selection to verify measurement and publication on Ubicloud.

commit.message:
💿CI/CD(workflow): dispatch documentation refresh on benchmark completion (#6)

## Summary
- Dispatches the developer site documentation refresh (`qortoo/qortoo`'s
`docs.yml`) upon central benchmark completion.
- Adds dedicated unit tests exercising authorization checks, event and
repository validation, and manual dispatch without network access.
- Updates `docs/result-publishing.md` with execution contracts,
credentials (`WORKFLOW_PAT`), and manual retry instructions.

## Testing
- `python3 -m unittest -v tests/test_documentation_refresh.py` passed (2
tests ok).

commit.message:
💿CI/CD(workflow): dispatch documentation refresh on benchmark completion (#6)

## Summary
- Dispatches the developer site documentation refresh (`qortoo/qortoo`'s
`docs.yml`) upon central benchmark completion.
- Adds dedicated unit tests exercising authorization checks, event and
repository validation, and manual dispatch without network access.
- Updates `docs/result-publishing.md` with execution contracts,
credentials (`WORKFLOW_PAT`), and manual retry instructions.

## Testing
- `python3 -m unittest -v tests/test_documentation_refresh.py` passed (2

commit.message:
💿CI/CD(docs): skip redundant benchmark refreshes and centralize guidance (#9)

## Summary

Central benchmark completion currently requests a full website refresh
even when the same benchmark snapshot is already public. Skip that
automatic request when the public committed manifest matches the current
`bench-data` revision; keep refreshes for new data, lookup failures, and
all manual runs.

- Add a shared Performance guide covering official and PR candidate
workflows and result locations.
- Simplify the official run/recovery guide and keep publication rules in
the contract document.
- Extend the existing refresh tests without adding a state store or new
runtime module.

## Validation

- `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` —
60 tests passed.
- `actionlint` (including shellcheck) and `git diff --check` passed.
- Shared Mermaid diagrams rendered and documentation links checked
locally.

commit.message:
💿CI/CD(docs): skip redundant benchmark refreshes and centralize guidance (#9)

## Summary

Central benchmark completion currently requests a full website refresh
even when the same benchmark snapshot is already public. Skip that
automatic request when the public committed manifest matches the current
`bench-data` revision; keep refreshes for new data, lookup failures, and
all manual runs.

- Add a shared Performance guide covering official and PR candidate
workflows and result locations.
- Simplify the official run/recovery guide and keep publication rules in
the contract document.
- Extend the existing refresh tests without adding a state store or new
